notes.title: CrimeBloc Launches on Steam — New Round + Major Code Overhaul Underway!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615630/c4157c4568c235eb28c65eb563bcf823afe2a8b2.png"]
🚀 Welcome, Steam Players! New Round Now Live + Patch Notes + Free Promo Code
For the first time ever… CrimeBloc is on Steam!
If you are new here — welcome to the chaos. If you are returning — you already know exactly what kind of trouble you are about to get into.
[hr][/hr]What is CrimeBloc?
CrimeBloc is an 18-year-old text-based mafia game. Yes — you read that right. We have been running this thing for nearly two decades.

Over that time, the game has grown in depth (and a little bit of character… and dust).
Some features were designed in a different internet era entirely — but that is also part of the charm.

Now that we are live on Steam, we are not just sitting back. We are taking this opportunity to overhaul the entire game’s code.
This is not just a facelift — we are rebuilding the core of CrimeBloc to make it faster, more stable, and 100x better for players.

And yes — that also means deeper Steam integration coming soon:

Better achievement handling

Richer presence and status

Improved UI/UX across desktop, mobile and Steam

The current round is the beginning — the future of CrimeBloc is already in progress.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615630/9eb09f5ab606ce5447bf0839ca7910772b223364.jpg"]


[hr][/hr]Fixing the Old Bones
Before diving into this round’s new features — a quick note:
When a game has run for 18 years, there is bound to be a few bugs lurking in dark corners.
We have spent the first half of 2025 cleaning house:

✅ 83 Enhancements
✅ 109 Changes
✅ 67 Bug Fixes

That is 259 updates rolled out so far this year.
Some fixed bugs players had simply learned to live with. Some polished the game ready for its Steam debut.
The result: CrimeBloc is in the best shape it has been in years — with a complete code overhaul underway to take it even further.
[hr][/hr]This Round: What’s New?
The big one: PVE has been removed.
We are moving to a unified system and adding a reputation mechanic to Murder in the coming weeks. The streets will be dangerous — but every action will have consequences.

Other key changes:

• Hitman now usable once per week (and it costs more)
• Credits to Bullet conversion price increased
• Offline Progression added to Auto Theft & Crimes (disabled first week)
• St Petersburg added as a new city
• Linked Account System — no more re-signing up after death
• Organised Crime timers reduced to 12 hours
• OC payouts lowered
• Leveling is slower to improve pacing
• New Weekly OC (10 players) — launches every Friday
• Upvote & Downvote added to posts/comments
• Extort button added to profiles
• Lottery now shows 3 winners + updated payouts
• 10% of money from weekly player kills boosts Lottery jackpot
• Bullet stats now on Game Stats page
• Leaderboards reactivated & improved
• Buffed bullets payouts from Operations
• Lowered Life Insurance EXP return
[hr][/hr]What We Are Building Next
The dev team is now heavily focused on rebuilding CrimeBloc’s codebase — bringing in new systems that will:

✅ Modernise the game for 2025+
✅ Allow better Steam integration
✅ Smooth out performance on desktop, mobile and browser
✅ Future-proof the game for years to come

You will see parts of this rolling out steadily in the coming months.
We will also be opening a NextGen test server soon where players can preview and give feedback on the new systems.

Upcoming features include:

• Voting Websites in Daily Challenges
• Referral system
• More Criminal Job Achievements
• Credit Reward Programs
• Extortion Protection
• Casino Marketplace
• Weekly In-Game Cash Donation Drive
• Real-time Autotheft Shipping Timers
• Extortion of All Cars (unless garaged)
• Linked Bank Vault (no password required)
• UI showing Boss Fight Protection progress
• Account Activation Reminders
[hr][/hr]🎁 Free Promo Code (For Steam Players + Everyone Else)
To celebrate the new round + Steam launch:

Go to My Account → Promo Codes
Enter code: STEAM63

Claim your free reward and get started.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615630/45e56ebe388614a456acac38ec2e3b8e3c0b8e3d.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]Final Word
CrimeBloc is a game built by players, for players.
Some of you will be here to cause trouble. Some will be here to build an empire. Some will just try to stay alive.

However you play — welcome to the Bloc.
You are joining a game with 18 years of history and a future that is being written right now.

See you on the streets.

Play here: 

www.crimebloc.com


Or on Steam: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930110/CrimeBloc/"][/dynamiclink]
